Adversary can use send_nft to bypass payment
found_targets.evidence: The send_nft function calls self._transfer_nft(deps, &env, &info, &contract, &token_id)?; without performing any payment checks or handling approvals like transfer_nft does. This allows a user to send an NFT to a contract, bypassing the payment mechanism implemented in transfer_nft.
